description: This file appears to be a Go source file that implements server-side functionality for managing Android devices via network sockets, HTTP endpoints, gRPC, and WebSockets. It includes handlers for device registration, control, file access, service invocation, and proxying, indicating it serves as a core component of a device management backend.

classes.name: wsIoWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper around websocket.Conn to implement io.ReadWriteCloser for proxying ADB traffic.

methods.name: createUnixSocketEndpoint
methods.description: Creates a Unix socket server at a specified path.

methods.name: SetupDeviceEndpoint
methods.description: Sets up a Unix socket for device connections and returns a handler function.

methods.name: SetupControlEndpoint
methods.description: Sets up a Unix socket for control commands and returns a handler function.

methods.name: CreateHttpHandlers
methods.description: Creates an HTTP router with handlers for various device and server control endpoints.

methods.name: controlEndpoint
methods.description: Handles control messages from connected clients, such as pre-registration.

methods.name: PreRegister
methods.description: Handles device pre-registration flow, sending status updates to clients.

methods.name: deviceEndpoint
methods.description: Handles device registration and message exchange after device connection.

methods.name: grpcListServices
methods.description: Lists available gRPC services on a device.

methods.name: grpcListMethods
methods.description: Lists methods for a specific gRPC service on a device.

methods.name: grpcListReqResType
methods.description: Retrieves request/response type info for a gRPC method.

methods.name: grpcCallUnaryMethod
methods.description: Invokes a unary gRPC method on a device.

methods.name: grpcTypeInformation
methods.description: Retrieves type information for a gRPC service.

methods.name: openwrt
methods.description: Proxies requests to the device's OpenWRT system via reverse proxy.

methods.name: adbProxy
methods.description: Proxies WebSocket connections to the device's ADB interface.

methods.name: listGroups
methods.description: Lists all device groups.

methods.name: listDevices
methods.description: Lists all devices or devices within a specific group.

methods.name: deviceInfo
methods.description: Fetches detailed info about a specific device.

methods.name: deviceFiles
methods.description: Serves files from a device or applies interception if configured.

methods.name: createPolledConnection
methods.description: Creates a long-polling connection for device communication.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Forwards messages between clients and devices over long polling.

methods.name: messages
methods.description: Retrieves messages for long polling connection.
